'''2007 Illinois State Championship Brandon Schele LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Schele]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' From Team Ohio's Playbook: Copy Reid/Pistone. Netdecking > Revealing Actual Decks.
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
